column1: # The runs the paper's size ladder stands on, one per modality x architecture x size.
# This file is the list, not the numbers. Every value in the cross-check table is read
# from the run itself (scripts/ladder_checkpoint_crosscheck.py); what is recorded here is
# which run each rung names and where that choice is written down, so a rung can be
# argued with rather than guessed at.
# on_ladder=no means the size has no rung: the reason is in the note, and the run column
# names the closest arm when there is one, or "-" when there is none.
# genome_sequence has one size. The 21 subsets sit at that size, and the main table takes
# mammal_centered; the other 20 are the supplement. Four sizes do not apply there.
